question: Who among the following won the 'Crossword Book Award 2020' for a debut novel?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Madhuri Vijay.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Crossword Book Award 2020 award** for a debut novel was won by **Madhuri Vijay.**
 
• The award was given for her book on Kashmir named 'The Far Field'.
 
• **The Far Field** by Madhuri Vijay has also won the INR 25 lakh **JCB Prize for Literature**.
 
• Crossword Book Award was established in the year **1998.**
 
• The **aim** of the award is to create a prize equivalent to Western literary accolades such as the Booker Prize and the Pulitzer Prize.
 
• The **Raymond Group**, a textiles company, sponsored it from 2014.
